query: 75-year-old man: among male ICU patients 70–80 with RRT, what is the 90th percentile of the 48‑hour composite vital instability score? For the top decile, compare hypotension (MAP<65), tachycardia episodes, ICU LOS and mortality versus males 70–80 without RRT.
final_sql: SELECT percentile_cont(0.9) within GROUP (ORDER BY vital_instability_score) AS ninety_percentile, percentile_cont(0.1) within GROUP (ORDER BY vital_instability_score) AS tenth_percentile FROM vital_instability_score WHERE subject_id IN (SELECT subject_id FROM male_icu_patients);
